title: Restore the stock fork damping baseline

applicability.included: Exact standard US 2027 Yamaha YZ450F with original stock suspension.
excluded: Changed springs, revalving or replacement suspension

entry_state: Assembled bike with identified, serviceable stock suspension.
exit_state: Stock baseline or measured rider sag recorded; no internal overhaul performed.
preflight: Identify the exact bike and stock components. Save starting settings.
critical_stop_conditions: Unidentified adjuster or inability to reach a setting without force

source.review_note: Root author/source review and independent year_groups_research review accepted bounded setup. 2020 copyright locator corrected to4; no mechanical changes after review.

steps.title: Inspect both fork legs
steps.instruction: Support the bike upright. Check the tubes and joints for damage or leaks. Apply the front brake and compress the fork; it must return smoothly. Repair any fault before setting damping.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Save the starting settings
steps.instruction: Identify the bottom rebound and top compression controls using page 114. For each leg, gently turn each control toward its hard stop, counting and saving the original clicks. Never force a stop; actual total adjustment travel can differ from the nominal range.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Release trapped air
steps.instruction: Securely raise the front wheel. Remove the illustrated bleed screw on each leg, release the trapped pressure, and refit each screw at 1.3 N·m. Keep dirt out and close both screws before continuing.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Set rebound
steps.instruction: From gently seated full hard, turn each bottom rebound adjuster toward soft by 9 clicks. Match both legs and record the result.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Set compression
steps.instruction: From gently seated full hard, turn each top compression adjuster toward soft by 12 clicks. Match both legs and record the result.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Check the finished setup
steps.instruction: Lower the bike securely. Confirm both legs match, both bleed screws are closed, and fork movement is smooth without leaks. Record this as a stock starting baseline, then evaluate handling on a controlled ride.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.
